description: Unmeasured checks for the selected apply and exec boundaries only.

assertions.name: exact anchored source
assertions.statement: For --apply, resolve exactly one path#anchor and preserve its exact source bytes. An unreadable file, missing anchor, or duplicate anchor stops with no write and no exec.

assertions.name: owned replaceable span
assertions.statement: The only write is a separable trailing draft span inside the anchored section. Hold without writing for Manual UAT or M-entry ownership, a metadata-field draft, several entries, interleaved or trailing kept content, an open question, or a required heading deeper than H6. On a valid write, preserve outside bytes and fenced headings; render step headings as UAT step <N>: at H5 or one level below a deeper section.

assertions.name: stale guard and idempotency
assertions.statement: Immediately before replacement, re-read and compare the original exact bytes. Changed bytes stop without a write. An already-equal rendered span produces no write; a successful write reports the path and changed line range and ends with the Written back to closing rather than inviting --apply again.

assertions.name: named exec dispatch
assertions.statement: --exec delegates the refined script through the named /user-uat capability. It forwards --dry-run only when review-uat received --dry-run, automatically adds --ui when the refined script contains a Verify (visual — vision-judge) block, and never implicitly forwards --deep or --yes-side-effects. review-uat exposes no --ui invocation flag. Under --dry-run it relays user-uat's classification and safety listing, not a Step 5 execution report. It never executes steps inline; unavailable dispatch reports required_tool_missing and preserves the refined script.
